temple.name: The Temple of the Three
temple.desc: A sand-choked temple on the desert road

clue.title: Three gods at the door
clue.text: The temple's reliefs show a procession to a hidden tomb: Anubis first, then Horus, then Ra, each holding a key. Behind them a figure in bronze bands walks with an eye in its hands, and the text warns: 'He goes where the eye goes. Do not carry it from its place.'
